name: d3dApp
meaning: the D3DApp the frustum pushes render states to; its +0x28 is the IDirect3DDevice7

name: fovRad
meaning: this is the HORIZONTAL field of view, not the vertical one. Screen_SetProjection sets tanHalfFov = 512/(2h), i.e. half of the 512-wide virtual screen over the projection distance (0x52a74b-0x52a762). Mat44_SetPerspective puts cot(fov/2) on _11 (x). Both cull tests in this module bound camera-space x by z*tanHalfFov.

name: cullDisabled
meaning: When non-zero, Instance_UpdateVisibility 0x55cae3 (movzx at 0x55caee) marks every instance visible (INST_F_DRAWN) without a frustum test. Zeroed by Frustrum_Construct. Game_Frame sets it to 1 while a cinematic is active (g_cinePlayer active 0x71c450; writes at 0x5604f1/0x560515) and to 0 otherwise (0x560521). A scan of the asm finds no other reader.

name: flipWinding
meaning: inverts the signed-area facing test in the immediate mesh draw; 1 at construction

name: viewportWidth
meaning: d3dApp rect right minus left, as a float

name: viewportHeight
meaning: d3dApp rect bottom minus top, as a float

name: aspect
meaning: holds viewportHeight/viewportWidth after Frustrum_Construct, but Screen_SetProjection overwrites it with viewportWidth/viewportHeight (fld +0x1C; fdiv +0x20; fstp +0x24 at 0x52a786-0x52a791), which is the value in effect during play. Cull_IsAabbVisible and Instance_UpdateVisibility multiply the horizontal half-extent by it to get the vertical bound.

name: viewDistance
meaning: the reference draw distance the fog band is anchored to; 100.0f at construction, changed by Frustrum_SetViewDistance. Mesh_DrawImmediate rejects triangles using 1.0f/viewDistance.

name: fogEnabled
meaning: gate for Frustrum_GetFogValue and the D3DRENDERSTATE_FOGENABLE write; 0 at construction

name: fogColor
meaning: D3DRENDERSTATE_FOGCOLOR value, masked to 24 bits by Frustrum_SetFog

name: fogMode
meaning: selects the ramp curve in Frustrum_BuildFogRamp: 1 = exp, 2 = exp squared, 3 = linear (the construction default), anything else = no fog

name: fogStart
meaning: near edge of the fog band, pushed as D3DRENDERSTATE_FOGSTART; 1.0f at construction

name: fogEnd
meaning: far edge of the fog band, pushed as D3DRENDERSTATE_FOGEND; 1.0f at construction

name: fogScale
meaning: 255.0f / (fogEnd - fogStart), cached for the per-vertex fog lookup in the mesh submission code. It is +INF between construction and the first Frustrum_SetFog because fogEnd == fogStart == 1.0.

name: fogRamp
meaning: precomputed vertex fog factors in the top byte of each word (0xFF000000 = no fog, 0 = fully fogged), indexed by trunc(normalised depth * 255)
